messages.content_text:
After 10am opened high then had a strong close below KO
I was looking to take shorts off of the KO
Also had a 5/15m CISD a couple points above the level 
Also a 1m OB.
And yestyurdays 18:00 KO
I entered right off 10am with 10pt stop 
I got stopped literally to the TICK
It then dumped straight down to asia lows almost without a pullback
I was pissed and logged off for the day.

This trade I could have done 2 things

If i was wanting to limit, I should have put it at the highest level, not the first.
,
It ended up going all the way to CE of the 1m OB

I could have scaled down to 15s and waited for a RB entry, as we had a perfect one.
,
Or even instead of liiting we could have just waited for that first candle to close 
Once we see it closed respecting the level, THEN we can enter.

1st Trade
Right at open we wicked down into the unfilled 15m FVG
Making an SMT inside the gap.
Had a nice 1m RB then tapped ce of it
I entered after rejecting the CE.
I was nervous though and ended up going B/E super quickly
AGAIN
Being a fuckin pussy and not accepting the risk.
Was the exact same trade that powell took but i got B/E

This shit needs to stop, if your putting the trade on then let it breathe.
Lots of time youll have a CISD around your entry and its retapping it.
Thats why it feels like you get ticked out every time.
Let it retest before you ever move to B/E
And take out the ITL/ITH

Today was a weird day.
I bought a new alpha account to trade cpi this morning.
I totally blanked and completly forgot about CPI this morning.
Didnt notice until 5:35 and realized I missed it.
Then hopped on and fullported a retracement that would have [assed the account
But i also didnt know the account had a 1k DLL on it and it liquidated me
Almost top ticked me out of the trade before going in my direction.
I was PISSED.|
Went for a walk and had a shower and finished my morning routine.
But I got to the charts again later than normal and only had like 10 minutes before open
to analyze. So i didnt do a daily bias or mark out any trade ideas.
I came in BLIND.
Also took a loss in asia last night so came into the day red already.
All in all, horrible conditions for the psych.
Honestly I should have just called it a day.

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
jan 13 Notes:


Today I took a $200 loss which is ok I’m not upset about it at all I am actually happy that I put some risk on the table today. It was cpi and the morning volatility wasn’t very good, but it did in fact get better later on.
,
CPI was bullish and I was expecting price to sweep the low and the overnight low and then rallied. As New York opened, Price made a relative equal high with the data high and then went down and swept both of the lows I was looking for. I missed the first trade of the day which was after the low was swept and then price reacted, accumulated a little, reswept on nq making an smt and a rejection block entry. (Screenshot 1)
,
Price made a big move up and then I started to look for my next trade which was a 1h cisd with the 10:00 key open. I marked a block where I wanted to see price rejected that was between the 10:00 open and the 50% of the range. Price traded into there and made a reaction and I traded the retrace of that. I think that it was a good trade, but then a huge move came from nowhere when I was up on my position and took me out of the trade. There were relative equal highs and a retrace of a strong move. The thing I would improve on is to get an earlier entry and maybe even a limit off of the 10:00. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,

---
